info.title: Fingerpoint API proxy
info.description: A transparent HTTPS relay for LLM API requests from browsers, implemented by `worker/main.js`. The site proxy at `/api/proxy` accepts same-origin calls only; a self-deployed Worker also accepts the origins listed in `ALLOWED_ORIGINS` and answers on any path.

servers.description: Site proxy, for pages served from lm.ikale.io

get.description: Identifies a Fingerpoint proxy. The web app calls it from Check proxy; it takes no key and sends nothing upstream.

post.description: Sends `body` to the upstream endpoint `url` with the caller's key and streams the JSON or SSE response back unchanged, including the upstream status. For `anthropic`, the key goes upstream as `x-api-key` with `anthropic-version: 2023-06-01`, plus `anthropic-beta: fast-mode-2026-02-01` when `body` contains `speed`; otherwise as `Authorization`. Redirects are not followed and cookies are not forwarded. The upstream request times out after 250 seconds, and cancelling the call cancels it.

200.description: The upstream response, streamed unchanged. Other upstream statuses, such as 401 or 429, are relayed as they are.

400.description: The body is not a JSON object, the protocol is unsupported, the model is missing, or the upstream URL is not a public HTTPS endpoint of the protocol.

502.description: The upstream redirected, returned an unsupported content type with a success status, or could not be reached.

504.description: The upstream did not answer within 250 seconds.

options.description: Answered by a self-deployed Worker for the origins in `ALLOWED_ORIGINS`. Browsers send it on their own before a cross-origin `POST`.

204.description: The origin is allowed. The response carries `Access-Control-Allow-Origin`, `Access-Control-Allow-Methods: GET, POST, OPTIONS`, `Access-Control-Allow-Headers: authorization, content-type` and `Access-Control-Max-Age: 7200`.

403.description: The origin is not allowed; the response has no CORS headers.

upstreamKey.description: The API key of the upstream service. The proxy does not store it.

url.description: The complete upstream endpoint: HTTPS on port 443, a public host name, no credentials, query or fragment, ending in `/chat/completions`, `/responses` or `/messages` for the chosen format.

body.description: The request body for the upstream API, sent as it is.

Error.description: An error raised by the proxy itself.

Forbidden.description: The page's origin may not use this proxy, or a same-origin proxy received a cross-site request.
